annotations.title: Sanctions screening: OFAC, UK, EU and UN lists

description: Screen a person, company, ship or aircraft against the OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, the UK Sanctions List, the EU consolidated list and the UN Security Council list, refreshed daily. Fuzzy matching with a score per hit. Use it when: Before onboarding a customer, paying a supplier, shipping an order, accepting a wire or signing a partner: any KYC, KYB or export check that asks whether a name is sanctioned. Not for: Politically exposed persons (PEP), adverse media, or crypto wallet addresses. It is a screening aid, not legal advice. Returns: A verdict (no match, possible match, strong match) and each hit with its score, list, listed name and the name that matched, programs, date of birth check, countries, reference and listing date, plus which lists were screened and when they were last updated. Typical time: about 1 s. Price: $0.010 per name, charged only on success. One call = one name screened against five sanctions lists.

country.description: Nationality or country, e.g. Iran. Shown as countryMatch on hits

dob.description: Date or year of birth (e.g. 1972 or 1972-05-14). Confirms or weakens a person match

lists.description: Only these lists. Default all five

name.description: The full name of the person, company, ship or aircraft, in any word order

type.description: Only match this kind of listing. Default any
